88: #### Problem 2 — AI Compute Costs Are Prohibitive at Enterprise Scale
89: 
90: - The average ASEAN enterprise deploying GPT-4-class models spends **USD 0.014 per 1,000 output tokens**. At scale (50M tokens/month), this equates to **USD 700,000/year in inference costs alone**.

92: - No ASEAN-native token optimization layer exists; enterprises are forced to rely on US-hosted cloud APIs with **latency penalties of 180–340ms** round-trip from Southeast Asia.

94: #### Problem 3 — Agentic AI Has No Production-Grade ASEAN Infrastructure
95:

97: - The "last-mile" problem: **74% of ASEAN enterprise AI pilots** fail to reach production (McKinsey, 2025) due to lack of orchestration, security, and managed deployment infrastructure.
98: 
99: #### Problem 4 — AI Literacy Gap Is Costing ASEAN Enterprises USD Billions
100: 
101: - Malaysia alone faces a deficit of **135,000 AI-literate knowledge workers** by 2028 (TalentCorp Malaysia).
102: - Existing training programs are either too academic (universities) or too generic (Coursera, Udemy). Enterprise-specific, use-case-driven AI upskilling is absent from the ASEAN market.

# Vector One Holdings - Potential Customers Database

This document serves as a comprehensive database of prospective clients and target accounts for Vector One Holdings, segmented by our five core product/solution subsidiaries. 

---

## 1. Vector Aero (C-UAS / Unified Command Gateway)
**Target Profile:** Defense Ministries, Airport Authorities, Critical Infrastructure Operators, Naval/Port Authorities.
**Key Personas:** Director of Procurement (Defense), Head of Infrastructure Protection, Chief Security Officer (CSO).

| Organization | Country | Sector | Target Persona | Key Pain Point / Driver | Engagement Strategy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Malaysia Armed Forces (ATM) / MINDEF** | Malaysia | Defense | Director of Procurement | Drone incursions, need for MCMC-compliant solutions, offset obligations. | G2G MoU, Joint feasibility study with STRIDE. |
| **Indonesia National Armed Forces (TNI)** | Indonesia | Defense | Head of Defense Acquisition | Border security, KKIP offset policy requirements. | KKIP offset partnership, Jakarta Defense-AI Forum. |
| **Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP)** | Philippines | Defense | DND Procurement | Base defense modernization (DND Modernization Program 3). | Pilot deployment at forward bases. |
| **Malaysia Airports Holdings Berhad (MAHB)** | Malaysia | Aviation | Director of Security Operations | MAVCOM/ICAO mandates for active drone detection (KLIA, Penang, KK). | MAVCOM compliance briefing, free site survey. |
| **PSA Singapore** | Singapore | Maritime/Port | Head of Infrastructure Protection | Congested maritime environment, false-positive reduction. | Direct enterprise outreach, DSTA pilot validation. |
| **Pelabuhan Tanjung Pelepas (PTP)** | Malaysia | Maritime/Port | Chief Security Officer | Port perimeter security, drone surveillance threats. | Direct outreach, site survey proposal. |
| **PETRONAS** | Malaysia | Oil & Gas | Director of Security Operations | Refinery and offshore platform vulnerability to asymmetric drone threats. | Leverage existing digital transformation relationships. |
| **Defence Science and Technology Agency (DSTA)** | Singapore | Defense | DSTA Procurement | Fast-track AI-enabled defense solutions, high-tech border security. | Singapore DSTA Pilot, tech co-development study. |
| **UAE Ministry of Defense** | UAE | Defense | Head of Acquisition | Infrastructure protection, integration with UAE AI Strategy 2031. | G2G Malaysia-UAE MoU, UAE Defense Roadshow. |
| **PT Angkasa Pura** | Indonesia | Aviation | Director of Security Operations | Drone disruption at major hubs (e.g. Soekarno-Hatta). | Propose comprehensive C-UAS pilot via state-owned enterprises network. |
| **Changi Airport Group** | Singapore | Aviation | Head of Aviation Security | Airspace safety and uninterrupted operations. | Collaborate with DSTA for validation. |
| **Royal Thai Armed Forces** | Thailand | Defense | Defense Procurement Committee | Border surveillance and asset protection. | Thailand defense modernizaton roadshow. |
| **Port Klang Authority** | Malaysia | Maritime/Port | Chief Security Officer | Vast port perimeter vulnerable to airborne smuggling/surveillance. | Direct outreach and integration with maritime authorities. |
| **Bintulu Port Holdings** | Malaysia | Maritime/Port | Head of Security | Securing deepwater port and LNG export terminals from aerial surveillance. | On-site RF spectrum demonstration. |
| **PT Pelabuhan Indonesia (Pelindo)** | Indonesia | Maritime/Port | VP of Port Security | Large-scale port modernization and safety. | Joint proposal with Indonesian maritime integrators. |
| **Ministry of Defence Brunei** | Brunei | Defense | Director of Acquisition | Protecting small critical borders and oil infrastructure. | Direct G2G engagement. |
| **Royal Malaysian Navy (TLDM)** | Malaysia | Defense | Naval Base Commander | Protecting naval assets in port from swarm drone threats. | Live demonstration at Lumut Naval Base. |
| **Shell Malaysia** | Malaysia | Oil & Gas | Offshore Installation Manager | Protecting offshore rigs from unauthorized drone surveillance. | Pilot deployment on a single offshore platform. |
| **ExxonMobil E&P Malaysia** | Malaysia | Oil & Gas | Security Director | Mitigating espionage risks to high-value extraction assets. | Enterprise risk assessment proposal. |
| **Senai International Airport** | Malaysia | Aviation | Head of Operations | Complying with upcoming MAVCOM mandates for regional airports. | Cost-effective single-sensor UCG tier proposal. |
| **Singapore Police Force (SPF)** | Singapore | Government | Head of Special Operations | VIP protection and public event airspace security. | Mobile UCG unit demonstration. |
| **Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM)** | Malaysia | Government | Internal Security Dept | Border smuggling via drones and high-profile event security. | Offer mobile/tactical UCG deployments. |
| **Vietnam People's Armed Forces** | Vietnam | Defense | Procurement Department | Coastal defense and border surveillance. | Explore via ASEAN defense trade shows. |

---

## 2. Vector Compute (EvoMax Token Engine & MiniMax Reseller)
**Target Profile:** Enterprise Tech, FinTech, GovTech, Large Conglomerates, Telcos.
**Key Personas:** Chief Digital Officer (CDO), Chief Technology Officer (CTO), Head of AI.

| Organization | Country | Sector | Target Persona | Key Pain Point / Driver | Engagement Strategy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Maybank** | Malaysia | Banking/FinTech | Chief Digital Officer | High LLM inference costs, Bank Negara RMiT data sovereignty rules. | Free 30-day EvoMax audit showing token waste. |

| **Petronas Digital** | Malaysia | Enterprise Tech | Chief Digital Officer | Token bloat from large-scale agentic deployments. | Product-Led Growth (API sign-up), EvoMax trial. |

| **Kasikornbank (KBank)** | Thailand | Banking/FinTech | CDO | Reducing token costs, regional compliance. | Direct outreach, showcase MiniMax cost advantages. |
| **Abu Dhabi Islamic Bank (ADIB)** | UAE | Banking/FinTech | CTO | Enterprise AI rollout, need for Arabic/regional language support. | Pilot program via UAE roadshow connections. |

| **Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS)** | Singapore | Government/Finance | Chief FinTech Officer | Regulating and testing secure GenAI workflows. | Demonstrate EvoMax compliance features. |
| **United Overseas Bank (UOB)** | Singapore | Banking/FinTech | CDO | Scaling AI customer service bots without exploding opex. | API cost comparison showing -40% savings. |

| **Public Bank Berhad** | Malaysia | Banking/FinTech | CIO | Conservative AI rollout needing strict cost predictability. | Fixed-tier pricing proposal for initial AI pilots. |

| **Sea Limited (Shopee/Garena)** | Singapore | Tech/E-commerce | VP of Engineering | High volume customer service and product recommendation token burn. | Demonstrate semantic caching for repetitive queries. |
| **Traveloka** | Indonesia | Tech/Travel | CTO | Dynamic pricing and recommendation agents running up AWS bills. | API audit showing prompt compression benefits. |
| **Bukalapak** | Indonesia | Tech/E-commerce | Head of AI | Scaling seller-support AI agents cost-effectively. | MiniMax reseller pricing structure. |

---

## 3. Vector Intelligence (AI Agent-as-a-Service - AaaS)
**Target Profile:** Banks, Telcos, GLCs (Government-Linked Companies), Conglomerates.
**Key Personas:** Chief Digital Officer (CDO), CTO, VP of Automation.

| Organization | Country | Sector | Target Persona | Key Pain Point / Driver | Engagement Strategy |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Maybank** | Malaysia | Banking | CDO | Pilot hallucinations, lack of ERP integration, language gaps. | Demonstrate Bahasa Malaysia agent capabilities. |
| **Axiata Group** | Malaysia/Regional | Telco | Head of Automation | Customer service automation failing at 'last-mile' production. | Paid POC for telco-specific agentic workflows. |
| **Petronas Digital** | Malaysia | Enterprise | VP of Digital | Need for orchestrated multi-agent systems for supply chain/ops. | Consultative approach, map to 3 core workflows. |
| **SCB / KBank** | Thailand | Banking | CDO | Deploying agentic AI safely with compliance layers. | Showcase banking vertical AaaS launch (2028). |
| **ADIB / QNB** | UAE/Qatar | Banking | Head of AI | Need for secure, production-grade agentic infrastructure. | Enterprise license proposal with implementation fee. |
| **Malaysian Government Ministries (e.g. MOSTI)** | Malaysia | GovTech | Director General / CIO | MyDIGITAL Blueprint execution, public sector digital transformation. | Fast-track procurement for Bumiputera-led tech. |
| **AirAsia / Capital A** | Regional | Aviation/Tech | CDO | Enhancing customer service bot with multi-agent orchestration. | Demonstrate AaaS capabilities for high-volume customer queries. |
| **Tenaga Nasional Berhad (TNB)** | Malaysia | Energy/Utilities | CIO | Predictive maintenance and smart grid agentic workflows. | Pilot program for infrastructure monitoring. |

**Target Profile:** Corporations, GLCs, Government Ministries, SMEs.
**Key Personas:** Chief Human Resources Officer (CHRO), Head of Learning & Development (L&D).
